record.q: Lt. Gov. Billy Nungesser won reelection Saturday night

record.t: Served as Chairman of the National Lieutenant Governors Association from July 2019 to July 2020.
record.q: From July 2019 to July 2020, Nungesser served as Chairman of the National Lieutenant Governors Association, a professional association which charts issues and work to be pursued by the second-highest ranking officials in all 50 states and U.S. territories.

record.t: Was elected Lieutenant Governor of Louisiana in 2015 and took office in January 2016.
record.q: Billy Nungesser is the 54th Lieutenant Governor of the state of Louisiana. He was elected in 2015 and took office in January of 2016.

record.t: Ran for Plaquemines Parish President in 2006 and was re-elected in 2010.
record.q: Billy decided to run for Plaquemines Parish President in 2006. He was re-elected in 2010 with over 70% of the vote.

record.t: Serves as Commissioner of the Department of Culture, Recreation and Tourism.
record.q: Today Billy is second-in-command in the executive branch and Louisiana's ambassador as Commissioner of the Department of Culture, Recreation and Tourism.

record.t: Led a delegation to France to promote international travel to Louisiana.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Billy Nungesser is leading a delegation to France to promote international travel in a country with strong ties to Louisiana.

record.t: Said his office is in talks with about 15 potential partners who want to set up businesses at Louisiana state parks.
record.q: Lt. Gov. Billy Nungesser’s office is in talks with about 15 potential partners who want to set up businesses at Louisiana state parks, Nungesser said Monday.

record.t: Said his office is studying the feasibility of a resort and conference center on 500 state-owned acres next to Lake Pontchartrain.
record.q: As an example of what might be possible, Nungesser mentioned a resort and conference center at a state park in West Virginia that he said created more than $50 million in public revenue in a little over six years. He said his office is studying the feasibility of doing something similar on 500 state-owned acres next to Lake Pontchartrain.

record.t: Said he is expanding outreach to international visitors.
